subject: Differences in number of quantified peptides between MSstats steps

messages.author: 3e5f36701cee0fa8
messages.subject: Differences in number of quantified peptides between MSstats steps
parts:
Hello,
I have Skyline DIA data I've processed in MSstats and have different numbers of unique peptide sequences between the different steps (they actually increase in number over the steps?) and I am trying to figure out why this is happening, as I can't figure it out from the documentation. From the skyline output file -> SkylinetoMSstatsFormat() -> dataProcess(), the number of unique peptides counted from the peptide sequence columns increases. I would understand if the number decreased due to filtering, but this doesn't seem to be the case. Any ideas?
Thanks!
